requirements.title: IS_IOSTAT_EOR detects end-of-record IOSTAT values
requirements.definition: IS_IOSTAT_EOR returns true exactly for IOSTAT stat-variable values that indicate an end-of-record condition.

pending.IS_IOSTAT_EOR-true-for-end-of-record-sta: Use ISO_FORTRAN_ENV, only: IOSTAT_EOR; assert IS_IOSTAT_EOR(IOSTAT_EOR) is true with a companion false check for zero and mutate the named constant to IOSTAT_END.
